Notes_and_Tips: Avoid bottle gourd completely due to your allergy.
Maintain regular meal timings as much as possible despite your irregular schedule.
When sweet cravings occur, have a fruit first and wait 10 minutes before eating anything else.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Stay well hydrated, especially on days with dance practice.
Continue yoga regularly and use your dance sessions as part of your daily physical activity.
Aim for consistent sleep timings whenever possible to support recovery, energy levels and fat loss.
